::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 91,877 people lived in County Laois, up 8.5% on 2016. It had the 18th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 60% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Laois was €1,235, the 12th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Laois

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Laois was €25,270, the 22nd highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Laois was €318,400, the 14th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 9.2 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Laois, the 4th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 24% of households in County Laois rented their home, the 15th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 16% of people living in County Laois were born outside Ireland, the 22nd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 40% of people aged 3 and over in County Laois said they could speak Irish, the 14th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 28% of people at work in County Laois worked from home for at least part of the week, the 17th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 77% of people travelling to work in County Laois went by car, the 8th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Laois live more than 1.9 km by road from a GP, the 16th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Laois live more than 15.2 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 20th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 14.6% of County Laois in 2021, the 5th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
